title: Emberwake
tagline: The Great Ember is going out. Keep the Wake, break their guard, and find who is snuffing the light.
description: A compact story JRPG in hand-built pixel dioramas. On the longest night of the year a grey stranger steals Kindlewick's shrine-ember, and apprentice wickwarden Rook sets out after it — gathering Bram, a miner with a hammer called Pebble, and Ines, a tide-reader searching for her father. Explore two towns, a living overworld and three dungeons; fight visible enemies (strike first, or slip past) in readable turn-based battles where you hunt weaknesses to Break shields, bank and spend Boost Points, and time button presses for bonus damage and blocks. Levels, skills, equipment, shops, inns, shrines, a bestiary, three save slots plus autosave, and a complete story with a real ending.
controls: Move WASD / arrows / left stick / touch pad · Act Enter / Space / Z / Ⓐ · Back / run X / Shift / Ⓑ · Menu Esc / P / Start · Boost Q R / LB RB / ± · Timed press: press Act as the ring closes (or tap)
fablePass: Music: Kindlewick hearth waltz, Saltmere shanty, overworld travel theme, three dungeon beds, battle theme with a Break stinger layer, three boss themes, Emberwake finale + credits song
Battle choreography: keyed wind-ups and follow-through per weapon, per-skill VFX timing, camera cuts on Break and boss phases, hit-stop
Character animation: richer walk/run cycles, talk gestures, idle fidgets; boss idle loops (Rootmother breathing roots, Brinewarden claws, Morrow's cloak)
Encounter transition (ember-swirl shatter) and the ending sequence: the Great Ember splitting into a hundred sparks over the sea
Ambient soundscapes per map (festival crowd, surf and gulls, dripping cave, wind on the spire)
